games.name: Backrooms: Survival
games.desc:
Backrooms: Survival is a survival game where you noclip out of reality and find yourself trapped in the eerie Backrooms.
Explore creepy, unsettling rooms, solve puzzles, manage your inventory, gather loots, and avoid dangerous creatures.

It's not overly hardcore, but surviving alone can still be challenging, so bringing friends is a smart move.

Explore, loot, survive... and try not to get lost.

Game is not yet finished. Expect occasional glitches and bugs in-game.

games.name: Subterra ⛏️ [BETA]
games.desc:
Welcome to Subterra ⛏️! 
It's a 2.5 dimensional mining game with a procedurally generated world where you dig deeper, upgrade your pickaxe and survive layers that get more hostile the further you descend.

❓ [ How to Play ]
- Mine ores and upgrade your pickaxe to go even deeper.
- Build your character with Ability Cards.
- Craft Weapons that help you defeat monsters.
- Obtain rare recipes of weapons and potions.
- Explore various layers.
- Defeat Monsters and Bosses!

💻 [ Controls ]
- E to open Inventory
- C to Interact
- F to Block/Parry
- Left Mouse to Mine

💾 [BETA] 
The game is still under development, expect various changes. 
If you find bugs or have suggestions let us know in the community server!

Thank you for playing!
